rationale: The native materializer and the baked C++ binding helper now bind a level display from a meter value key alone, as the ui.js bridge already does, passing the key in the existing NativeImportMeterBindingDescriptor::value_key with an empty meter_source and channel. Public header core/view/include/pulp/view/design_import.hpp: a doc comment on NativeImportMeterBindingDescriptor only; its fields (route_id, meter_source, channel, value_key, event_contract) and every declaration are unchanged. Private header core/view/src/design_binding_metadata.hpp (not installed): adds the inline member `bool NativeBindingMetadata::has_meter_input() const`, true for a meter source plus channel or a non-empty meter_value_key; no data member changes. design_cpp_binding_codegen.cpp and design_import_native_common.cpp call it in place of the source-and-channel test. No DesignIR schema field (IRNode, DesignIR, or a pulp* binding attribute) is added, removed, renamed or retyped: pulpMeterValueKey was already parsed into meter_value_key. No Chromium capture, renderer backend, asset or packaging authority moves.
